rule: DECISION_003.md §2 (unchanged in DECISION_004.md §3): eligible only if (1) open weights publicly downloadable, (2) licence permits research use, (3) PRIMARY domain = pretrained on surgical or endoscopic video (or video frames), (4) documented pretraining data

judging_conventions.open_weights: PASS if official weight files are listed publicly (HF API listing or an official public download URL resolving to the file, checked by HEAD / API metadata only) without a manual-approval step; HF gated='auto' click-through = PASS with a gating flag; manual approval / request form / e-mail = UNKNOWN; no official weights or dead link = FAIL. No weights downloaded, no terms accepted.
judging_conventions.licence_research_use: PASS if the quoted licence text covers (non-commercial) research use; FAIL if research use is not permitted; UNKNOWN if no licence text is found for the weights/code.
judging_conventions.domain_primary: PASS if the released checkpoint's own (self-/weakly-supervised, contrastive or generative) pretraining or domain post-training corpus is surgical or endoscopic video or frames sampled from such video (general-domain initialisation allowed and recorded); FAIL if surgical data are used only for a task-specific fine-tune/adapter on a generic backbone, or the training images are not endoscopic/surgical; UNKNOWN if the documentation does not say whether the images are video frames.
judging_conventions.documented_pretraining_data: PASS if the paper / model card names the datasets or named sources of the surgical/endoscopic pretraining or post-training stage that qualifies the model under the domain criterion (named public datasets, named institutions, named web platforms with URL lists or counts); FAIL if described only generically; UNKNOWN if the naming document is not accessible. The documentation level of a general-domain initialisation / base model is recorded in the basis and decides the Appendix300 check, not this criterion.
judging_conventions.appendix300_check: YES if DS203/Appendix300 (doi 10.25532/OPARA-1173, issued 2026-04-29) or its source recordings/centres' appendectomy recordings are listed. Lineage = training data of the released weights plus the data of their initialisation / base / frozen-backbone weights (distillation teachers are recorded in the note but do not decide). NO only if every lineage component is a closed list of named datasets / institutions, or in-house data whose documented institutions, geography or modality exclude the Appendix300 centres' laparoscopic appendectomy recordings, or a closed curated benchmark (ImageNet, Kinetics, SSv2...). UNKNOWN if any lineage component is undisclosed, web-scale (e.g. CLIP, DINOv2 LVD-142M, LLM/VLM or Cosmos base data) or open-ended web-scraped (YouTube, HowTo100M, WebSurg), so the source recordings cannot be excluded. Initialisation that is not documented at all is noted as a caveat.
